What every test returns

test_results.Rd

Every exported perform*Test() function returns a base-R htest object, so a result prints, subsets and composes like the result of stats::t.test() or lmtest::bptest(). This page lists every field such a result can hold: the five every test returns, the two optional htest fields some return, and the fields a few tests add. tests/testthat/test-return-contract.R checks every exported test against it.

Fields of every test

statistic

the test statistic: a numeric value of length one, named after the statistic ("X-squared", "F", "t", "GQ", "LM", "z", ...).

parameter

the parameters of the null distribution: a numeric vector whose elements are named, usually degrees of freedom ("df", or "df1" and "df2"). The resampling tests store the number of replications here ("B", "permutations"), and the tests on ordered observations the sizes they use ("n", "m"). It is NULL for performPesaranTest(), whose statistic is referred to the standard normal distribution.

p.value

the p-value: a single number between 0 and 1.

method

a character string naming the test. When an argument switches between two statistics, such as studentize in performHarveyTest(), the string says which one was computed.

data.name

a character string describing what was tested: the formula of the model, followed for some tests by the variance regressors. For performBoxMTest(), which tests data rather than a model, it names the data and the grouping.

Optional htest fields

alternative

a character string describing the alternative hypothesis, returned by the tests that have a direction or a stated alternative.

estimate

estimates that accompany the statistic: a named numeric vector (performSzroeterTest(), performSpearmanTest(), performVarianceFormTest()), or, in performQuantileRegressionTest(), a matrix of slope estimates with one column per quantile and named rows and columns.

Fields some tests add

p.value_bootstrap

performWhiteTestRobust() and performBPTestRobust() with bootstrap = TRUE: the bootstrap p-value.

robust_details

performWhiteTestRobust() and performBPTestRobust(): a list with the confidence interval, effect size, bootstrap results, power and sample size, and method or studentized, the setting that chose the statistic.

boot_statistics

performWhiteTestBootstrap(): the bootstrap replicates of the statistic.

bootstrap

performWildBootstrapTest(): a list with the replicates, the number of usable ones, the multiplier distribution and the observed statistic.

permutation

performRankPermutationTest(): a list with the replicates, the number of usable ones and the ordering variable.

projection

performHighDimensionalTest(): a list with the number of principal components kept, the share of the variance they explain and the threshold that chose them.

variance_function

performVarianceFormTest(): a list with the form of the variance function, its regressors and the added terms that were tested.

quantiles, se_type, iid

performQuantileRegressionTest(): the quantiles compared and the settings of the standard errors.

chunks_processed, chunk_size, r_squared

performWhiteTestStreaming(), performBPTestStreaming() and performKoenkerTestStreaming(): how the data were read and the \(R^2\) of the auxiliary regression.

res

performSpatialHeteroTest(): the Monte Carlo replicates of Moran's I from spdep::moran.mc(), whose class "mc.sim" the result keeps.

Attributes

performWhiteTest() and performWhiteTestRobust() attach the attributes auxiliary_regressors, original_regressors, cross_products_included and r_squared_auxiliary, which describe the auxiliary regression. runHeteroTests() adds attributes of its own to each result it returns.

See also
